timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’ve been giving so much to everyone else.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is full of everyone else's needs.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can’t remember the last time I asked what I needed.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep noticing how tired I feel.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels depleted from all of this giving.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want someone to take care of me for once.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels guilty for even wanting a break.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I’m running on empty.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: There’s nothing left over right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can notice my own needs without guilt.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Caring for myself isn’t selfish.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask for help instead of doing it all alone.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t have to earn rest.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body deserves care too.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can take a small moment just for myself.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to have limits.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can give from a fuller place instead of an empty one.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let something be lighter today.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m worthy of the same care I give others.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to know when I need to refill.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask for support without shame.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can take care of others without disappearing.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can find rest, even in small pieces.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to receive, not just give.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I matter in this too.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can protect a little space for myself.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let myself be cared for.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
